summary.text: Andrew Fitzgerald is the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 98 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after defeating Ruth Ann Gallagher in the June 2 Democratic primary; he faces Republican Nathan Ramker.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described a career in skilled trades and manufacturing and named public schools, career and technical education, and health care costs among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Fitzgerald said in a Ballotpedia survey that he was born and raised in Davenport, Iowa, and graduated from Davenport West High School.
He wrote that he has worked as a mechanic at Lujack's, in maintenance at Kraft, where he was a UFCW union member, and as an automation technician at Invio Automation.
Fitzgerald won the 2026 Democratic primary with 52.8 percent of the vote to Gallagher's 46.9 percent, according to Ballotpedia.

In the survey, he said he wants to strengthen public schools, expand career and technical education, expand health care access and lower costs, support small businesses, and rebuild roads and bridges.
